headline: Portfolio Outperformance vs. SPY YTD
summary: As of July 16, 2026, the portfolio set is outperforming the SPY benchmark with an average return of 17.88% compared to SPY's 10.79%. This results in an average alpha of 7.10%, indicating that the portfolios are not only gaining in absolute terms but are also ahead of the benchmark. The top portfolio, 'Random A', has delivered an impressive return of 48.84%, significantly contributing to the overall performance. In contrast, the weakest portfolio, 'Google 100', has returned 11.13%, still above the benchmark but less impactful. This outperformance is particularly relevant during periods of market stress or uncertainty, highlighting the portfolio's relative strength. Note: Updated 30 minutes before and after market close.
